description: Swipe estimates high-latitude electrodynamics from Swarm drift measurements and Swarm and CHAMP magnetic observations. It calculates potentials, fields, convection and electromagnetic work independently for each hemisphere. The resource is documented by NASA Community Coordinated Modeling Center (metadata publisher; developer not specified). The documented physical domain is High Latitude Ionosphere / Auroral Region; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Public Repository, Instant Run. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. The empirical representation depends on the observation-derived relationships; available examples do not constitute independent performance validation. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. Spatial and temporal resolution were not independently established.
